name: clawd-chain-main
description: A public, standalone SVM (Solana-compatible) chain for the clawd ecosystem. Native token label: **CLAWD**. It runs a single Agave `solana-test-validator` (v2.2.20) on Railway behind a small Node gateway (`proxy.js`) that serves HTTP RPC and WebSocket on one HTTPS domain. Metaplex Core, Core Candy Machine and Core Candy Guard are preloaded (cloned from mainnet at genesis).
